implementation_status: Ready source URLs for cloud intake after source manifest/group admission review; yearly field/label comparability validation and original study recodes remain required. This plan does not mutate the shared manifest.
required_companions: SAS source variable labels and format/value-label programs
Overview, response rates, quality/comparability notes and weighting formula
State module participation matrix and multiple-questionnaire archives/weights where item optional

panels.calculation: Source code2010 1=very satisfied,2=satisfied,3=dissatisfied,4=very dissatisfied; HDR reverses direction to very dissatisfied1 through very satisfied4. Thus for those verified codes HDR_score=5-source_code. Year-specific labels must validate before any calculation.
panels.original_weighting: Not verified from accessible original study; do not assert weighted recreation.

panels.definition: Respondent reports mental health not good on exactly30 of past30days. Not depression diagnosis, not14+days indicator.
panels.calculation: Within validated year/age/geography/module population, numerator is MENTHLTH==30 and denominator valid MENTHLTH day responses including zero via code88. Source88 means no days, never88 days. Missing77/99/blanks excluded and counts disclosed. Original study weighting, pooling, year convention and smoothing remain unverified.

original_figures.original_source: Blanchflower2025b NBER Reporter: The Global Decline in the Mental Health of the Young
original_figures.definition: Share reporting exactly30 poor mental health days; groups females age<25,males age<25,all respondents age35–54. Adult sample18+; source sex definition retained.
original_figures.axis_year_labels: 1993–2023 shown; exact terminal data year/annual file versus interview year requires original source reconciliation, not inference from download date.
original_figures.historical_intake_needed: At least1993 throughreportera2024 archives, newer2025 separate;1991/92 additionalpublichistory does not imply sameitem present.
original_figures.original_weighting_and_uncertainty: Not yet verified; author study original weighting/source cohort and uncertainty must be matched before exact recreation.

MENTHLTH.meaning: Number of days mental health not good in preceding30days, stress/depression/emotions included
MENTHLTH.missing_codes: 77=unknown/not sure,99=refused,blank=not asked/missing; preserveoriginal code then normalized missingtype
MENTHLTH.despair_rule: Exactly30; _MENT14D and depression diagnosis are different measures

LSATISFY.meaning: Ordinal life satisfaction, not mental disorder score
LSATISFY.hdr_recode: For reviewed source direction,5-valid_source_code; retain source and calculation separately.
LSATISFY.module: Core in2010 source section22.2;2022 SAS saysModule16SocialDeterminantsandHealthEquity. Optional module/state/questionnaire coverage and appropriate weights required for each relevant newer year.

depressive_disorder.definition: Ever told by doctor/healthcareprovider depressive disorder. NOT the HDR despair definition. No interchangeable time series across unreviewed aliases.

age_sex_state_time.constraints: _AGE80 imputed/capped age is not automatically actual single-year respondentage. Preserve AGE and derived age fields with exact annual metadata. Sex fields/wording vary byyear and current source revisions; no blanket sex/gender equivalence. Read surveyyear versus IYEAR interviewyear before pooling. State and territory inclusion explicit eachyear.

comparability.before: Earlier landline/poststratification design; _FINALWT confirmed1993. Year-specific weights/design must be reviewed.
comparability.after: Raking plus cellphone frame; core _LLCPWT with _STSTR and _PSU. Module versions may require _LCPWTV1/_LCPWTV2/_LCPWTV3.
comparability.official_status: CDC2024/2025 says not directly comparable with pre2011years. Do not render an uninterrupted same-definition series without this break and approved harmonization method.
comparability.state_coverage: 2024 excludesTennessee;2025 excludesCalifornia,Mississippi,Nevada,USVirginIslands. Optional life satisfaction jurisdictions differ. A pooled analysis is an author calculation, not an official nationwide CDC estimate.
comparability.release_revisions: 2024 currentCDC publicdata explicitly modified afterexecutiveorders; removedquestions maycause inconsistentmissingfields. The HDR-original author snapshot may differ from currentarchives; retain immutable sourceversions and disclose mismatch.

live_assessment: 2025annualarchive publishedAugust2026 is newer same source, not real-time. CDC has monthly emergencydepartment syndromic indicators but differentpopulation/denominator; no substitution for exact30-day survey despair prevalence.
